scope: super_dome full build, Blender-only, provisional. Evidence art/dome/overview_250_day.png, overview_250_night.png, pilot_atrium_night.png, pilot_gallery_L1.png, L2_cutaway.png, L2_club.png, L2_arcade_room.png, L2_arcade_prism.png, L3_hotel_rooms.png, L4_cutaway_units.png, build_stages.png. Rubric v5_rubrics.md 3.9, including the section 0 tone check.

tone_check_club.detail: The Club (L2_club.png, L2_cutaway.png) is a dance floor with coloured light tiles, three podiums with chrome poles, a mirror ball, a lit bar and lounge booths. No human dancers, no sexual imagery, no signage beyond the venue name. The robot dancers (ART-NPC) are not in the evidence, so their tone is not checked yet. No bouncer, door or 'adults only' sign is visible; V5 section 8 asks for a bouncer at the door and section 0 says children never enter the club.
tone_check_club.required: Show a bouncer post and an 'ADULTS ONLY' sign at the club door; rate the robot dancers when ART-NPC delivers them.

round_26_fixes_checked.1 break the L3-L5 grid, neon round the r: landed partly: windows now vary in width and colour (amber, cream, cool blue, dark) and several neon bands (magenta, cyan, green, amber) run round L1-L2 (art/critic/r28_night_crop.png). No balconies or planters on the upper floors; the upper floors still read as an even grid from the side.
round_26_fixes_checked.2 night glass: landed: the shell now has a warm glow and the lit edge ring; it reads as glass at night (overview_250_night.png).
round_26_fixes_checked.3 day glass reflection: partly: the glass reads light and clear, with a faint sky tint; still no visible fresnel reflection at the grazing edge.
round_26_fixes_checked.4 signs: NOT landed, and the cause is not the column: the sign font has no letter B and a broken P. 'BARBER' renders as 'AR ER', 'BOOKS' as 'OOKS', 'PRISM SHIFT' as 'FRISM SHIFT' (r28_signs_crop.png, L2_arcade_prism.png, pilot_atrium_night.png).
round_26_fixes_checked.5 venue goods: partly: the L2 cutaway shows shelves with coloured goods (toys, books, shoes, gifts); the L1 cafe goods are still plain boxes.
round_26_fixes_checked.6 pool: landed: lane lines and a dark lane edge.

venue_quality.atrium_night: the best image: escalators, neon shop signs on two levels, pool with lanes, palms, warm lamps. It reads as a mall and a resort.
venue_quality.L2_cutaway: good from above: food court, gym, toys, books, shoes, game zone with arcade cabinets and VR rings, the Club with dance floor and booths.
venue_quality.club_close: mood lighting works; the geometry is bare: flat grey walls, a box bar, a blank wall of cyan panels, large empty floor. Needs booths in view, a DJ booth, a stage backdrop and ceiling truss lights.
venue_quality.arcade_close: cabinets read as arcade machines with neon; the Prism Shift cabinet has a flat pink screen (RENDER's shader is still to come) and the marquee glyphs are broken. The room is a large empty purple floor with one pool table and one bench.
venue_quality.L3_hotel_rooms: weakest part: huge rooms with a bed, a desk and a chair on bare floor; blank walls. Estimate 0.60 on its own.
venue_quality.L4_units: good from above: a full ring of furnished homes with beds, sofas and tables in varied colours.
venue_quality.build_stages: good: foundation with a site crane, level structure with scaffold, the dome frame, finished. Each stage reads.

gap_to_paul_aim.night_overview_250m: Nearly there: a warm glass shell over a ring of multicoloured windows and neon bands, a bright atrium. The last step: sparkle and variety on the upper floors (balconies, a few very bright windows, moving light such as the lifts) and the city lights reflected in the glass. Estimate 0.76 (0.80 = glitters).
gap_to_paul_aim.day_overview_250m: Reads as a domed city with colourful neon at street level. Estimate 0.72.
gap_to_paul_aim.inside: The atrium and the L1/L2 galleries now feel like a mall and a resort. Estimate 0.76. Hotel rooms, the club and the arcade at close range pull it down.

fixes.fix: Sign font: add the missing letter B and fix P (BARBER, BOOKS, PRISM SHIFT are wrong). Render every sign string in one test sheet so no glyph is missing.

Hotel rooms (L3): fill each room: headboard bed with bedside lamps, a lounge chair and side table, wardrobe, TV on the wall, a rug, a wall picture, a window with curtains, a bathroom pod door. Target: no empty floor patch wider than 2 m.

Club close-up: a DJ booth with decks on a raised stage, a light truss with spotlights over the floor, lounge booths along the wall in view, a textured back wall (acoustic panels or a LED wall pattern), and a bouncer post with an ADULTS ONLY sign at the door.

Arcade: 10-14 cabinets in rows (not 6 along one wall), a prize counter, a neon floor pattern, seating; give the Prism Shift cabinet a distinct shape (sit-down racer cabinet with a seat) so it stands out before RENDER's screen shader.
Upper floors outside: balconies or planters on every third unit and 3-5 very bright windows per side, so the ring sparkles at 250 m.
L1 cafe: cakes, cups and a menu board instead of plain boxes (round-26 fix 5, still open).
Day glass: a fresnel reflection at the grazing edge (round-26 fix 3, still partly open).
In-game: the 250 m night shot with glow, draw calls, fps in the follow view inside the dome, and the arcade screen shader. The final score needs this.
Deliver the robot dancers for the tone check (chrome, visible joints, light-bar face, performance style).

notes: PASS 0.76 (was 0.74), provisional. Tone check PASS for the set; robot dancers not yet in evidence.
The broken sign font is a new finding: in round 26 I attributed BARBER to a column; the letter B is missing from the font.
